game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the cave miner must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 7: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for C origins.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Guess Until Right' (Week 4 slot 7), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Bat Hollow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
